name: Isomorphic Finite-Dimensional Operator Substitution
description: Replaces the continuous linear differential operators (which models easily pattern-match to self-adjointness properties via quantum mechanics or calculus heuristics) with finite-dimensional matrix transformations that share the exact same algebraic property (commute, cross-product is symmetric, self-products are not). This forces models to genuinely evaluate the composition and discover the bipartiteness constraint from scratch, bypassing any memorized shortcuts.
